title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Maintain a Human Resources (HR) program to formally manage the organization's workforce members.

title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Maintain a Human Resources Information System (HRIS) to track the status of each organization's workforce member.

title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the organization's Human Resources (HR) program performs background screening for each workforce member.

title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the organization's Human Resources (HR) program requires workforce members to agree to the organization's terms and conditions of employment or similar appropriate contracts.

title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the organization's Human Resources (HR) program includes a process for workforce members to return physical assets after their work with the organization.

title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the organization's Human Resources (HR) program includes a process for workforce members to return information assets after their work with the organization.

title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the organization's Human Resources (HR) program includes a process for workforce members to return authentication credentials after their work with the organization.

title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Maintain an inventory of each Identity Provider (IDP) the organization approves.

title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the organization minimizes the number of Identity Providers (IDPs) it uses and utilizes centralized Single Sign On (SSO) solutions whenever possible.

title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Maintain an inventory of each user account authorized by the Identity Provider (IDP).

title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Maintain a configuration benchmark for each of the organization's authorized Identity Providers (IDPs).

title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the configuration benchmarks for each of the organization's Identity Providers (IDPs) do not allow workforce members to share accounts.

title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the configuration benchmarks for each organization's Identity Providers (IDPs) do not allow concurrent account logins.

title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the configuration benchmarks for each organization's Identity Providers (IDPs) do not allow account names to be reused within a defined period of time.

title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Define a process the organization will use to regularly perform identity reviews of each of the organization's Identity Providers (IDPs) to ensure only authorized accounts exist in the system.

title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Maintain an identity management system to provision accounts for workforce members once automatically added to the organization's Human Resources Information System (HRIS).

title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Maintain an identity management system to automatically de-provision accounts for workforce members once they are tagged as inactive in the organization's Human Resources Information System (HRIS).

title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the configuration benchmarks for each of the organization's Identity Providers (IDPs) require strong passwords.

title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the configuration benchmarks for each of the organization's Identity Providers (IDPs) require account lockouts if a defined threshold of failed login attempts is exceeded.

title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the configuration benchmarks for each organization's Identity Providers (IDPs) require that passwords be stored encrypted and hashed using salts.

title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the configuration benchmarks for each of the organization's Identity Providers (IDPs) require passwords to be transmitted only when encrypted.

title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the configuration benchmarks for each of the organization's Identity Providers (IDPs) require a process for secure password provisioning by the organization's helpdesk.

title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the configuration benchmarks for each of the organization's Identity Providers (IDPs) require using Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).

title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the configuration benchmarks for each of the organization's Identity Providers (IDPs) require that unused accounts are automatically disabled after a period of not being used and/or require the use of expiration dates on each account.

title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the configuration benchmarks for each of the organization's Identity Providers (IDPs) require logging logon events for standard accounts, whether successful or failed.

title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the configuration benchmarks for each of the organization's Identity Providers (IDPs) require logging access to deactivated accounts.

title: Identity Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the configuration benchmarks for each of the organization's Identity Providers (IDPs) require logging User Behavior Analytics (UBA) events.
